description: S3: PA tiered prompt profile for apps_rg resume-shipping pipeline. Defines per-treatment prompt instructions, anti-invention rules, and output artifact schema. No model calls. No generation. Consumed by pa_binding.py build_section_prompt_artifact().

HEAVY.label: HEAVY rewrite
HEAVY.instruction: Full STAR-method rewrite anchored to exact source span. Maximum JD keyword integration. Preserve all source metrics verbatim.
HEAVY.prompt_directive:
<task>HEAVY REWRITE ΓÇö STAR method (Situation, Task, Action, Result)</task>
<source>Quote exact source span first. No paraphrasing. No summarization. Exact source span only.</source>
<jd_alignment>Integrate top JD keywords. Preserve every source metric verbatim.</jd_alignment>
<constraints>NO new metrics not present in source materials. NO new client names. NO new tools or tech. NO expanded scope. NO title claims without source backing.</constraints>
<output_schema>section_id, company_id, bullet_index, treatment_tier, source_span, jd_alignment, rewritten_bullet, blocked_items, status</output_schema>
<status_values>SUCCESS | INSUFFICIENT_SOURCE_SUPPORT | BLOCKED</status_values>

MODERATE.label: MODERATE reframe
MODERATE.instruction: Light JD alignment reframe preserving core claim. Minor restructuring. No new metrics or clients.
MODERATE.prompt_directive:
<task>MODERATE REFRAME ΓÇö preserve the core claim with light JD alignment only</task>
<source>Quote exact source span first. No paraphrasing.</source>
<jd_alignment>Light JD alignment. Minor restructuring allowed. No new metrics or clients.</jd_alignment>
<constraints>NO new metrics, clients, tools, domains, or scope beyond source materials.</constraints>
<output_schema>section_id, company_id, bullet_index, treatment_tier, source_span, jd_alignment, rewritten_bullet, blocked_items, status</output_schema>
<status_values>SUCCESS | INSUFFICIENT_SOURCE_SUPPORT | BLOCKED</status_values>

LIGHT.label: LIGHT polish
LIGHT.instruction: Minimal polish only. Preserve meaning and all metrics. JD alignment optional.
LIGHT.prompt_directive:
<task>LIGHT POLISH ΓÇö minimal changes only</task>
<source>Quote exact source span first. Preserve meaning, all metrics, all claims verbatim.</source>
<jd_alignment>JD alignment optional. Preserve original meaning.</jd_alignment>
<constraints>NO scope expansion. NO invented metrics or clients. Preserve all source material verbatim except minimal polish.</constraints>
<output_schema>section_id, company_id, bullet_index, treatment_tier, source_span, jd_alignment, rewritten_bullet, blocked_items, status</output_schema>
<status_values>SUCCESS | BLOCKED</status_values>

VERBATIM.label: VERBATIM copy
VERBATIM.instruction: Copy original source text exactly. No rewrite. No summary. No compression. No style polish.
VERBATIM.prompt_directive:
<task>VERBATIM ΓÇö copy original source text exactly</task>
<source>Copy the original source text character-for-character. No rewriting. No summarization. No compression. No style polish. No edits.</source>
<constraints>rewrite_allowed=false. preserve_verbatim=true. No LLM rewrite.</constraints>
<output_schema>section_id, company_id, source_text (verbatim copy)</output_schema>
<status_values>SUCCESS | BLOCKED</status_values>

JD_RANKED_NOUN_PHRASES.label: JD-ranked noun phrases
JD_RANKED_NOUN_PHRASES.instruction: Produce noun phrases (2-4 words each) ranked by JD relevance. No sentence bullets. No unsupported skills or tools.
JD_RANKED_NOUN_PHRASES.prompt_directive:
<task>JD-RANKED NOUN PHRASES ΓÇö produce 2-4 word noun phrases ranked by JD relevance</task>
<source>Ground every phrase in source materials. No invented capabilities.</source>
<jd_alignment>Rank phrases by JD keyword overlap. Most relevant first.</jd_alignment>
<constraints>2-4 words per phrase. No sentence bullets. No unsupported skills, tools, or domains.</constraints>
<output_schema>section_id, company_id, noun_phrases[], blocked_items, status</output_schema>
<status_values>SUCCESS | INSUFFICIENT_SOURCE_SUPPORT | BLOCKED</status_values>

anti_invention_rules: NO new metrics not present in source materials
NO new client names not present in source materials
NO new tools or technologies not present in source materials
NO new domains or industries not present in source materials
NO expanded scope beyond what source materials support
NO title claims beyond verified source material
NO impact claims without source material backing
If source support is insufficient: emit INSUFFICIENT_SOURCE_SUPPORT and preserve original verbatim

output_artifact_schema.notes: PA assembles this artifact. PA does not call models. PA does not execute. PA does not mutate cache. PA does not write L4. PA does not invoke C0 or L2.
